statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (W : WeierstrassCurve k) [W.IsElliptic] {β : W.toAffine.Point →+ W.toAffine.Point}, β ∈ WeierstrassCurve.rationalHomSet k W W → ∀ (t q : ℤ), β.comp β + q • AddMonoidHom.id _ = t • β → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → (p : ℤ) ∣ q → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ t → ∃ T : W.toAffine.Point, T ≠ 0 ∧ p • T = 0
